assertions.name: edge_set_is_max_contact_packing
assertions.source: binding-max ⇒ max #bonds subject to 3D hard-core ⇒ max-contact packing; for A≤4 max-contact = simplex C(A,2), so no isotope may fall below it. Surplus over simplex: D +0.00, T +0.81, 3He +0.92, 4He +7.13 (D = 0 by construction, it defines b*; the ⁴He excess is 3-body M_3, not extra edges — Part 7). A chain or any sub-simplex edge set would drive one of these negative. Resolves #2089 chain-vs-complete. Cluster/halo deviation open.

description: EXPLORATORY: the nuclear edge set is variationally selected by binding-maximization (B~Σ_bonds b*, b* const) ⇒ the max-contact 3D sphere packing (between chain A−1 and complete C(A,2)). Resolves #2089's chain-vs-complete: neither, max-contact. Pairwise edges ≈ simplex C(A,2) for A≤4; ⁴He magic surplus = 3-body Milnor M_3, not extra edges.
